title: tm issue record
description: One line of a tm export or an adapter's output, version 1 (ADR 0013). A reference to another Issue is another record's source, a Key, or an Issue id. Times are RFC 3339.

source.description: <system>:<id>, such as beads:tm-u8g.10; a tm export writes tm:<Issue id>. A re-import finds the Issue by it.

project.description: The key of the Issue's Project.

key.description: The Issue's Key where it came from; shown, never assigned.

type.description: An Issue type id, such as task.

status.description: A Status id, such as in_progress.

reporter.description: Who created it; the import's runner when absent.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it; a re-import writes as them, else as its runner.

type.description: A Link type id, such as blocks.

comments.description: Shown comments; a retracted one is not carried.

on_behalf_of.description: The human an Agent wrote it for.

shortlist.description: The Short-list it is on (ADR 0016); never a rank. An import matches the list by source, then by name, and creates one it cannot match, taking its Actors and size from the file's project line for that source, else the import's runner and size 10.

source.description: The list's source; a tm export writes tm:<list id>. An import matches it first, then the name.

name.description: Absent only for a list a merge brought without one; an import cannot create such a list.
